# unifi_network_firewall_group (Resource)

A UniFi firewall group (`firewallgroup`, legacy `/rest`) — a reusable set of addresses or ports referenced by `unifi_network_firewall_rule` via its `src_firewall_group_ids`/`dst_firewall_group_ids`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name.
- `type` (String) Group type: `address-group` (IPv4 addresses/CIDRs), `port-group` (ports), or `ipv6-address-group` (IPv6 addresses/CIDRs). Immutable — changing it replaces the group.

### Optional

- `members` (Set of String) Members: IPs/CIDRs for an address group, port numbers/ranges for a port group. Empty groups are allowed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Controller object ID (`_id`). Import key.
